We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied first three templates, got some precursors. Need to continue with template 149040 then 1914391.

We need to construct a JSON route tree: root molecule is target SMILES. Then reaction node with template 29646, children are precursors (list). Then each precursor may be further broken down with next template etc. The order must be sequential: first reaction uses 29646 to break target into some precursors. Then for each of those precursors, we apply next template? Usually route is linear: each step transforms one molecule to precursors, then next step applied to one of those precursors? The task says route must have at least 5 reactions, using templates in this order. Likely a linear chain: each reaction takes the product of previous step as input. So we need to apply template 29646 to target, get a precursor A. Then apply 1914389 to A, get B. Then 1914390 to B, get C. Then 149040 to C, get D. Then 1914391 to D, get final starting materials.

We need to get actual SMILES from each apply_template result. The apply_template returned tuples of strings. For first template 29646, result gave three possible outcomes: each a tuple with one SMILES? Actually result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three possible precursors. Need to pick one that can be further processed by next template 1914389. We used the first one (with Si protecting group) and applied 1914389, got result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So two precursors from that reaction: one is the same core with Si and a carbonyl (CC=O) and the other is an ester/ phosphonate? Actually second is "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". That seems a side product.

We need to continue with template 1914390 applied to which precursor? Probably the main core: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C". We tried applying 1914390 to that and got empty. Also applied to the second precursor and got empty. So maybe we need to choose a different precursor from first step that works with 1914389? Let's try other options from first template.

Option 2: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". Apply 1914389.
